name: diag_full
_comment: all cut-points relax 0.15 -> 1.0; spans the sub-0.25 collapse and full recovery

name: diag_knee
_comment: dense zoom into the band where reserve starts to fail / recover

name: diag_mid
_comment: entirely inside the healthy-but-compressed band; fine curvature, far from cliff

name: front_only
_comment: only the front-half layers compress (back held at baseline) -> tests front sensitivity

name: back_only
_comment: only the back-half layers compress (front held at baseline); compare vs front_only for layer asymmetry

name: depth_gradient
_comment: graded compression by depth (early layers hit hardest), all relaxing to baseline
